status_semantics.CLOSED: The gap has a tested, versioned mechanism adequate for the current CIVPROP development boundary. Closure does not claim every future production-scale value is already calibrated.
status_semantics.OPEN: The current default executable still contains a placeholder, missing state/output, or incomplete production mechanism owned by this gap.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Work cannot proceed without an unresolved dependency outside the gap.

gaps.name: REAL_INPUT_COMPILER
gaps.meaning: Replace synthetic Method Lab scenario with frozen adapters from loom_earth, loom_solar, loom_timeline, resource evidence and actor authority.
exit_criteria: Promoted authority is captured read-only with source/query/file hashes.
A frozen compiler deterministically produces a runner-compatible package.
Values are mapped only where semantics align; unresolved values remain named assumptions.
The default runner accepts the compiled package and reports compiler provenance.
Live recapture and deterministic recompilation are tested.
gaps.next_action: Keep the compiler boundary stable while later gaps replace assumption-register entries. Before a full 2026-2226 production run, expand compiler coverage beyond the current Earth-Luna 2026-2036 development slice without changing semantics silently.

gaps.name: ACTOR_STATE_AND_BUDGETS
gaps.meaning: General actor identities, spendable allocations, access rights, contracts, owned capacity and budget state are not yet production modeled or emitted.
exit_criteria: Versioned actor-state contract distinguishes identity, ownership, operation, access, rights/contracts, capability, experience and spendable allocation.
2026 boundary values have explicit authority or declared model provenance.
Future actor state changes only through auditable events/transactions.
Actor budgets are not GDP, national capital stock, or unscoped macro investment proxies.
Current AUS scenario-credit and generic-capability placeholders are removed from the default compiled input.
gaps.next_action: Build ActorState/ActorBudget V1 and replace ASSUME-GAP002-AUS-BUDGET and ASSUME-GAP002-AUS-CAPABILITIES.

gaps.name: TRANSPORT_ACCESSIBILITY
gaps.meaning: Current accessibility/generalized costs are synthetic fixture inputs rather than a general Solar transport service.
exit_criteria: A versioned accessibility service accepts origin, destination, epoch, mission/service class and technology/actor state.
It preserves FEASIBLE, INFEASIBLE and UNKNOWN and returns provenance plus limiting constraints.
Generalized cost is decomposable into physical/service quantities with units and uncertainty.
Qualified Solar geometry is consumed without confusing straight-line separation with route length.
Synthetic Method Lab accessibility profiles are removed from the default compiled input.
gaps.next_action: Generalize the existing tri-state transport boundary into the Solar accessibility adapter used by Hybrid V1.

gaps.name: DEMAND_AND_PRESSURE_MODEL
gaps.meaning: Transport, industrial, habitat and resource demand signals are synthetic exogenous series; production causal demand equations remain to be built.
exit_criteria: Demand/pressure signals are derived from explicit civilization state rather than hand-authored annual series.
Drivers include only versioned causal inputs such as population, production, scarcity, accessibility, installed capacity, trade or strategic commitments.
Pressure components and units are documented and testable.
Pressure decay/relief responds correctly when underlying demand disappears.
Current OFFWORLD_* and WATER_RESOURCE_DEMAND fixture series are removed from the default production path.
gaps.next_action: Define Demand/Pressure V1 equations and hostile tests for no-demand, congestion relief, local-optimum and strategic-investment cases.

gaps.name: PROJECT_ECONOMICS
gaps.meaning: Method Lab costs, lags and capacity units are preserved fixtures, not production economics or calibrated technology curves.
exit_criteria: Infrastructure archetypes have versioned parameter sets with physical/economic units and provenance.
Costs, construction lags, scale behavior, output capacity and prerequisite capacity are not scenario_credit fixtures.
Parameter uncertainty and technology-year dependence are represented explicitly where needed.
Dorrington-Olsen or other domain models are used only within their qualified scope.
METHOD_LAB_SYNTHETIC_V1 values are absent from the default production path.
gaps.next_action: Create the first qualified/scenario production parameter set for the Earth-Orbit-Luna slice, then extend by archetype and technology epoch.

gaps.name: MISSIONS_AND_KNOWLEDGE_UPDATE
gaps.meaning: Hybrid V1 baseline does not execute prospecting missions or CIVPROP-0 observation/Bayesian knowledge updates.
exit_criteria: Mission/action archetypes are distinct from infrastructure archetypes.
Actors choose missions using actor-visible knowledge only.
Observations are noisy and conditioned on hidden physical realization plus instrument capability.
Knowledge updates are deterministic given seed/evidence and produce auditable events.
Updated beliefs feed later economics/decisions without hidden-truth leakage.
gaps.next_action: Integrate the proven CIVPROP-0 observe/Bayes loop into Hybrid V1 as a mission/event lane.

gaps.name: PRESSURE_OBSERVABILITY
gaps.meaning: Pressure levels are internal; only pressure-qualified events are emitted.
exit_criteria: Pressure state is emitted or reproducibly reconstructable per year/location/archetype.
Pressure components, accumulation, decay, qualification threshold and discharge are inspectable.
A decision can be traced back to the exact pressure state that qualified it.
Observability does not alter engine decisions or random draws.
gaps.next_action: Add a versioned pressure-state output surface and regression tests without changing Hybrid V1 behavior.

gaps.name: RESOURCE_MASS_BALANCE
gaps.meaning: Resource capacity is abstract; stock, grade, throughput, yield, depletion and inventory are not yet modeled.
exit_criteria: Resource state distinguishes evidence/belief from hidden physical realization.
Extraction and processing conserve mass through stock, grade, recovery/yield, inventory and depletion accounting.
UNKNOWN abundance remains unknown rather than becoming zero or an invented inventory.
Facilities cannot produce resource flows beyond qualified physical/model constraints.
gaps.next_action: Promote the resource-state contract into CIVPROP runtime state and connect extraction/processing modules to mass-balance flows.

gaps.name: PRODUCTION_AND_VALUE_ADDED
gaps.meaning: Off-world sector production, value added, operating cost and investment flows are not yet generated.
exit_criteria: Off-world production has explicit inputs, outputs, capacity utilization and operating costs.
Value added, investment and productive capital have documented units and accounting identities.
Production is constrained by power, labor/automation, materials, transport and installed capacity as applicable.
Body/facility aggregates reconcile with underlying facility/sector flows.
gaps.next_action: Define off-world sector/production accounting V1 using Earth accounting semantics where transferable and new off-world semantics where necessary.

gaps.name: POWER_BALANCE
gaps.meaning: Power is abstract installed capacity; average demand, peak demand, storage, generation mix and energy closure are not yet modeled.
exit_criteria: Installed generation capacity is distinct from average generation, peak demand and consumed energy.
Facilities and populations create explicit load.
Storage/reserve/availability assumptions are versioned where relevant.
Energy use closes within tolerance at each modeled location/time step.
Atlas average/peak power fields derive from runtime state rather than arbitrary capacity indexes.
gaps.next_action: Add PowerState/PowerFlow V1 and connect infrastructure loads and generators.

gaps.name: TRAFFIC_AND_FLEET
gaps.meaning: Cargo, passengers, ship calls, fleets, queues and route utilization are not yet generated.
exit_criteria: Transport demand becomes route/service flows with explicit cargo and passenger units.
Fleet/service capacity constrains realized movement.
Ship calls and utilization derive from flows and vehicle/service capacity.
Traffic reconciles across origin/destination and feeds transport pressure/economics.
gaps.next_action: Define Traffic/Fleet V1 after GAP-003 accessibility and GAP-004 demand provide the necessary upstream signals.

gaps.name: FACILITY_AND_SITE_MATERIALIZATION
gaps.meaning: Module colocation, named facilities, settlements, surface sites, orbital elements and Atlas facility types are not yet materialized.
exit_criteria: Generated modules can colocate/aggregate into stable sites without copying the legacy Ceres answer sheet.
Surface sites and orbitals receive reproducible spatial identity/placement appropriate to available authority.
Facility lifecycle, owner/operator and module composition are preserved.
Atlas-facing facility types are derived/materialized from generated capability composition.
Naming is presentation metadata and cannot alter simulation state.
gaps.next_action: Build the deterministic site/facility materializer from generated infrastructure module state.

gaps.name: MAINTENANCE_DEPRECIATION_RETIREMENT
gaps.meaning: Infrastructure maintenance, depreciation, replacement, failure, retirement and abandonment are not yet production modeled.
exit_criteria: Infrastructure has age/lifecycle state and explicit maintenance/replacement requirements.
Depreciation, failure, retirement and abandonment alter usable capacity through events.
Replacement investment is separated from growth investment.
Facilities do not persist forever without operating/maintenance consequences.
gaps.next_action: Define asset lifecycle V1 and connect it to project economics, production and event scheduling.

gaps.name: DEMOGRAPHIC_DEPTH
gaps.meaning: Cohort demography, births/deaths, synthetic persons, biological viability and long-run settlement demographics are not yet connected.
exit_criteria: Off-world biological populations age, reproduce and die with explicit cohort/viability rules.
Migration integrates with rather than replaces demographic accounting.
Synthetic population/effective labor and machine task capacity have explicit semantics.
Workforce is derived from population/labor state rather than a Method Lab placeholder ratio.
Earth boundary demography remains reconciled with loom_earth.
gaps.next_action: Extend the annual state spine with cohort/labor composition adapters and off-world settlement demography.

gaps.name: ATLAS_DERIVED_METRICS
gaps.meaning: Economic/transport centrality, strategic significance and other Atlas display metrics must be derived after physical/economic state exists.
exit_criteria: Atlas derived metrics are deterministic functions of generated physical/economic/network state.
Metric formulas, normalization population and time scope are versioned and documented.
Derived scores never serve as circular primitive causes unless explicitly lagged and modeled.
Body/facility Atlas projections can be regenerated from a pinned CIVPROP run.
gaps.next_action: Define Atlas Derived Metrics V1 after traffic, economy, facilities and network state are available.

post_gap_plan.name: PRODUCTION_READINESS_FREEZE
post_gap_plan.purpose: Declare Engine V1 production-ready only after GAP-001 through GAP-015 are CLOSED, no EXPLICIT_PLACEHOLDER assumptions remain in the default package, and input/engine/output semantics are version-pinned.
exit_criteria: All 15 gaps CLOSED in the default executable output.
No unresolved scenario-credit or Method Lab production placeholders.
Full 2026-2226 horizon and required Solar/body coverage compile successfully.
One immutable production-readiness manifest pins all contracts and implementation hashes.

post_gap_plan.name: QUALIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
post_gap_plan.purpose: Hostile-test the completed engine before trusting a 200-year Solar-system propagation: replay, conservation, no-oracle firewalls, sensitivity/ensemble behavior, stress cases, known historical/control cases, and answer-sheet independence.
exit_criteria: Deterministic replay passes.
Mass/energy/population/economic accounting invariants pass where applicable.
No hidden truth leaks into actor decisions.
Stress and sensitivity suites expose bounded, interpretable behavior.
The old Ceres Atlas is not used as a target/calibration answer sheet.

post_gap_plan.name: REFERENCE_2026_2226_RUN
post_gap_plan.purpose: Execute the qualified 2026-2226 propagation and a declared seed ensemble. Preserve one immutable reference realization for downstream materialization and review; it is a simulation reference, not canon by default.
exit_criteria: Reference input package, engine version, seed/ensemble and output hashes are frozen.
Run completes over the full horizon without failed invariants.
Sensitivity across the declared seed set is summarized.
Reference realization selection, if one is selected, is documented without converting it into governing canon.

post_gap_plan.name: CIVPROP_RUN_AUTHORITY_AND_PERSISTENCE
post_gap_plan.purpose: Persist the accepted simulation result as immutable run authority, preferably in a dedicated loom_civprop persistence layer, while keeping Earth/Solar/Timeline source authorities separate and read-only.
exit_criteria: Run, events, state, facilities, flows, actors and provenance have stable persistent identities.
Source authority references remain external rather than copied as new truth.
A run can be reconstructed from the persisted manifest and immutable inputs.
Legacy CIVSTATE is treated as compatibility/projection, not propagation authority.

post_gap_plan.name: ATLAS_MATERIALIZATION_AND_COMPARATOR_REVIEW
post_gap_plan.purpose: Materialize the reference run into the celestial-body/orbital/facility Atlas and compare it with the original Ceres/Atlas material only as a comparator, not a destination or answer sheet.
exit_criteria: Every Atlas body/facility record traces to CIVPROP state or a transparent derived transform.
Centrality/strategic metrics derive from generated state.
Differences from legacy Ceres are reported and explained rather than force-fit.
Untouched/unsettled bodies remain valid outcomes.

post_gap_plan.name: SOLAR_COVERAGE_AND_RELEASE
post_gap_plan.purpose: Expand/confirm coverage across Earth orbit, Luna, Mars, Belt/Ceres and the outer system, then publish a versioned Atlas/CIVPROP release with explicit scope and uncertainty.
exit_criteria: Required Solar objects and placement classes are covered by the production input compiler.
No destination is forced to develop merely because it exists in the registry.
Release manifest pins run authority, Atlas materializer, derived metrics and source contracts.
Known residual limitations are published rather than hidden.

post_gap_plan.name: ENGINE_VARIANTS_AND_ITERATION
post_gap_plan.purpose: Only after V1 produces a qualified end-to-end world should alternative propagation engines or improved V2 submodels be compared. They should consume the same input/output contracts where semantics permit, so engine choice becomes an experiment rather than another architecture reset.
exit_criteria: V1 remains reproducible and preserved.
Any alternative engine declares contract compatibility or explicit version differences.
Comparisons use shared inputs, seeds/ensembles and Atlas materialization rules.
Promotion of a later engine follows the same qualification and immutable-run process.
